name: ksniff
description: Packet capture on Kubernetes pods — tcpdump any pod and stream traffic to Wireshark or a pcap file

install_steps: Install as a kubectl plugin: kubectl krew install sniff (binary lands as kubectl-sniff on PATH)
Or download kubectl-sniff from https://github.com/eldadru/ksniff/releases and move it to PATH

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install kubectl-sniff: Install as a kubectl plugin: kubectl krew install sniff (binary lands as kubectl-sniff on PATH)

commands.description: Capture traffic from a pod (kubectl-sniff mypod -n myns -o capture.pcap). Add -f for a BPF filter, -i for interface, -v to stream to Wireshark

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install kubectl-sniff: Install as a kubectl plugin: kubectl krew install sniff (binary lands as kubectl-sniff on PATH)

commands.description: Passthrough to kubectl-sniff (same as kubectl sniff) — pod arg plus tcpdump/filter flags

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install kubectl-sniff: Install as a kubectl plugin: kubectl krew install sniff (binary lands as kubectl-sniff on PATH)
